meta.title: Free solar quote – Grenchen, Solothurn & Bern
meta.description: Request a free, no-obligation solar quote. We assess your photovoltaic project in Grenchen, Solothurn, Bern and the surrounding area, clarify subsidies and prepare a transparent quote.

intro.title: Your project, assessed with no obligation.
intro.text: We assess your roof, clarify feasibility and subsidies, and prepare a clearly itemised quote. We only recommend what makes technical and financial sense.

inclusions.title: Included in every quote
items: Site analysis with shading and structural assessment
Sizing of modules, inverter and battery storage
Indicative profitability calculation with conservative assumptions
Check of the Pronovo one-off subsidy (EIV) and cantonal funding

calculator.text: The solar calculator provides the basis for your quote.

form.title: Request a quote
form.text: Tell us briefly about your plans – we will get back to you personally.
